questions.question: According to the manual, the new birth makes you both born and adopted into what?
Which of these is listed as something the New Birth is NOT?
options: The quickening of a dead spirit

questions.question: What is repentance described as in Study 2?
options: A firm conscious decision to turn from sin to righteousness
A ritual performed by pastors only

questions.question: Which of these is a step repentance must involve, per the manual?
Before salvation, how does the manual describe your former state?
options: A servant of sin, a child of the devil

questions.question: According to Study 4, what is one immediate thing God expects from a new believer?
options: Put off the old man and put on the new man

questions.question: How many books does the Bible contain, according to the manual?
What does the word 'Trinity' mean according to the manual?
options: The union of Three Divine Persons in one Godhead

questions.question: According to the manual, what is the Christian life described as regarding Satan?
options: Continuous warfare against our arch-enemy the devil

questions.question: Quiet time is described as time set aside for what purpose?
Which item does the manual list as something you require for quiet time?
The study on baptism describes the regenerating work of the Holy Spirit as different from what?
options: His work in the Old Testament

questions.question: What does Holy Spirit baptism impart, according to the manual?
Personal Evangelism is defined in the manual as what?
options: Person-to-person sharing of the gospel to lead someone to Christ

questions.question: According to the manual, malice can be defined as what?
options: Having a desire to harm others, or ill will

questions.question: What does the manual say unforgiveness can hinder?
How does the manual define 'discipline'?
options: The training of the mind and body to produce self-control and orderliness

questions.question: What does the manual say Biblical fasting means?
options: Abstaining from food and drink for a period of time

questions.question: According to the Divine Healing study, what is described as the 'original state of man'?
options: A state of health, as fearfully and wonderfully made

questions.question: The manual identifies what as one of the sources of illness?
What does restitution involve, according to the manual?
options: Restoring to the owner all things taken by falsehood
Only a private apology to God

questions.question: According to the manual, what percentage of income does a tithe represent?
How does the manual instruct believers to pay their tithes?
options: Promptly and cheerfully, with gratefulness to God

questions.question: Deliverance is defined in the manual as what?
options: Setting free — expelling demons, breaking yokes, removing curses
A one-time ceremony with no lasting effect
An Old Testament practice no longer relevant

questions.question: How many different types of deliverance does the manual mention?
According to Study 13, what is described as 'our garment'?
The manual describes 'strife' as involving what?
options: Contending or struggling with people over opposing views

questions.question: According to the manual's teaching on the tongue, believers must learn to do what?
options: Bridle the tongue and be careful with words

questions.question: What does the manual say about anger?
options: It is a destructive spirit that often leads to foolish decisions
It should be expressed freely at all times

questions.question: According to the manual, why is Biblical fasting considered imperative?
options: It is essential to deal with certain spiritual matters believers face
It is only a cultural tradition
It replaces the need for prayer

questions.question: What does the manual say Christ's death and resurrection guarantees, in relation to divine healing?
options: Only forgiveness of sins, nothing else

questions.question: According to Study 3 (Discovering Your New Self, Part I), who is used as an example of dramatic transformation?
What does the manual say the world will do to a new believer, according to Study 4?
According to the manual, cruelty is described as what?
options: Showing indifference to another's suffering or causing suffering
A form of discipline endorsed by the church

questions.question: Where should tithes be paid, according to the manual?
options: To the church where one fellowships/worships
